if.test: startdt != null and startdt != '' and enddt != null and enddt != ''

where.if: AND A.START_DT BETWEEN TO_TIMESTAMP(#{startdt} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AND TO_TIMESTAMP(#{enddt} || '235959', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')

mapper.sql: SELECT A.NOTICE_ID AS NOTICE_ID, A.TITLE AS TITLE, A.NOTICE_TYPE AS NOTICE_TYPE, A.USE_YN AS USE_YN, A.START_DT AS START_DT, A.END_DT AS END_DT, A.VIEW_CNT AS VIEW_CNT, A.REG_ID AS REG_ID, A.REG_DTTM AS REG_DTTM, A.UPD_ID AS UPD_ID, A.UPD_DTTM AS UPD_DTTM FROM SMS.NOTICE A
mapper.select: /* NoticeMapper.selectDetail */ SELECT A.NOTICE_ID AS NOTICE_ID, A.TITLE AS TITLE, A.CONTENT AS CONTENT, A.NOTICE_TYPE AS NOTICE_TYPE, A.USE_YN AS USE_YN, A.START_DT AS START_DT, A.END_DT AS END_DT, A.VIEW_CNT AS VIEW_CNT, A.REG_ID AS REG_ID, A.REG_DTTM AS REG_DTTM, A.UPD_ID AS UPD_ID, A.UPD_DTTM AS UPD_DTTM FROM SMS.NOTICE A WHERE A.NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
mapper.insert: /* NoticeMapper.insert */ INSERT INTO SMS.NOTICE ( TITLE, CONTENT, NOTICE_TYPE, USE_YN, START_DT, END_DT, VIEW_CNT ) VALUES ( #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{noticeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{useYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startDt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{endDt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{viewCnt,jdbcType=NUMERIC} )
mapper.update: /* NoticeMapper.update */ UPDATE SMS.NOTICE SET TITLE = #{title,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONTENT = #{content,jdbcType=CLOB}, NOTICE_TYPE = #{noticeType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, USE_YN = #{useYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, START_DT = #{startDt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, END_DT = #{endDt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, VIEW_CNT = #{viewCnt,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPD_DTTM = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND (UPD_DTTM = #{beforeUpdDttm,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} OR (UPD_DTTM IS NULL AND #{beforeUpdDttm,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} IS NULL))
mapper.delete: /* NoticeMapper.delete */ DELETE FROM SMS.NOTICE WHERE NOTICE_ID = #{noticeId,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
